provenance.title: D3LM: A Discrete DNA Diffusion Language Model for Bidirectional DNA Understanding and Generation
affiliations: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China
provenance.abstract: D3LM (Discrete DNA Diffusion Language Model) unifies bidirectional representation learning and DNA generation through masked diffusion in discrete DNA space. It adopts the Nucleotide Transformer (NT) v2 architecture but reformulates the training objective as masked diffusion (variable masking ratio, 1/t-weighted cross-entropy on masked tokens), enabling both bidirectional understanding and generation within one model. Two variants: D3LM (initialized from pretrained NT-v2 weights) and D3LM-R (random init). Compared to NT-v2 of the same size, D3LM improves downstream understanding; on regulatory-element generation it reaches SFID 10.92 (D3LM-R), close to real DNA (7.85) and far better than autoregressive (HyenaDNA 29.16) and continuous latent-diffusion (DiscDiff 62.74) baselines. Published at MLGenX 2026; weights released on HuggingFace.
key_claims: Masked diffusion (variable mask ratio) unifies bidirectional DNA understanding AND generation in one model, unlike BERT-style (fixed 15% mask, non-generative) or autoregressive (causal, unidirectional) models
D3LM-R reaches SFID 10.92 on 2048bp regulatory-element generation, approaching real DNA (7.85) and beating HyenaDNA (29.16), DiscDiff (62.74), Evo (1359.98), DPLM (95.34)
D3LM (NT-v2 initialized) matches or improves NT-v2 on downstream understanding (e.g. splice donor MCC 0.959 vs 0.915), showing the diffusion objective does not degrade representation quality
Random unmasking order beats confidence-based (MaskGit/entropy/top-k) sampling for DNA, reflecting non-local regulatory dependencies; T=50 steps and temperature 1.1 are optimal

architecture.primary_variant: D3LM-R (50M): NT-v2 backbone (ESM encoder + RoPE + SwiGLU), 12 layers, hidden 512, 16 heads, non-overlap 6-mer, masked-diffusion training

modules.name: SixMerTokenizer
modules.notes: 4096 6-mers (4^6) + 9 special incl. mask [M]. HF config may report 4107 (a couple extra reserved).

modules.name: RoPE
modules.notes: NT-v2 uses RoPE + SwiGLU over NT-v1.

modules.name: ESMEncoderLayer
modules.notes: NT-v2-50m-multi-species backbone. Bidirectional attention is essential (vs causal AR models).

modules.name: MaskPredictorHead
modules.notes: Predicts clean tokens at masked positions; CE loss weighted by 1/t (masking ratio).

mathematical_spec.name: Masked diffusion training loss (1/t-weighted CE on masked tokens)
Reverse denoising step (iterative unmasking)
mathematical_spec.latex: x_{t-1}^i = \begin{cases} \text{sample } p_\theta(x_0^i|x_t) & i \in U_t \\ [M] & i \in M_t \setminus U_t \\ x_t^i & \text{else} \end{cases}

data_augmentation: variable masking ratio t ~ U[0,1] per sequence
training_pipeline.curriculum: Masked-diffusion pretraining on EPD-GenDNA mammalian subset (~80k sequences, 2048bp). D3LM starts from NT-v2 weights; D3LM-R from scratch. Trained on NVIDIA A800 (BF16).

datasets.name: EPD-GenDNA (Li et al. 2024, DiscDiff dataset), mammalian subset

evaluation_protocol.compute: Generative training on a cluster of NVIDIA A800 GPUs (BF16). Downstream fine-tuning via HuggingFace Trainer + LoRA (r=1, alpha=32), up to 1000 steps, cosine LR, early stop patience 4.
special_conditions: 1000 generated sequences vs held-out reference for SFID
SFID uses Sei encoder (20k chromatin profiles) -> Frechet distance
downstream: MCC, mean-pool for sequence-level tasks

implementation_assumptions.assumption: Load official D3LM/D3LM-R weights from HuggingFace (Hengchang-Liu/D3LM-from-nt, D3LM-scratch) via AutoModelForMaskedLM(trust_remote_code=True) rather than pretraining
implementation_assumptions.basis: generative pretraining on A800 cluster is infeasible to reproduce; weights + custom diffusion_generate code are public

implementation_assumptions.assumption: Generation uses the model's bundled diffusion_generate() + MDMGenerationConfig (steps, temperature, top_p, unmasking algorithm)
implementation_assumptions.basis: HF model card shows this API

implementation_assumptions.assumption: SFID needs the pretrained Sei model (Chen et al. 2022, 20k chromatin profiles) to embed sequences; the metric is a Frechet distance in that space
alternatives: approximate with a lighter embedder for a proxy metric

implementation_assumptions.assumption: Non-overlap 6-mer tokenizer bundled with the weights (vocab ~4105)

ambiguities.description: Paper says 4105 (4096 + 9 special); HF config may report 4107. Minor.
ambiguities.primary_assumption: read vocab from the released tokenizer/config at load time

ambiguities.description: SFID requires running Sei on 1000 generated + reference sequences; Sei is a large genomic CNN.
ambiguities.primary_assumption: reproduce SFID only if Sei is loadable; else verify generation qualitatively (GC ratio, motif, diversity) which are cheap

ambiguities.description: 'mammalian subset ~80k of 160k'; exact species list not fully enumerated in main text.
ambiguities.primary_assumption: use EPD-GenDNA mammalian sequences per DiscDiff release
